blocks.text: Organic chemistry ki parhai functional groups ke gird tarteeb di gayi hai. Karoron organic compounds maloom hain, lekin functional groups sirf gine chune hain, aur har functional group organic compounds ki aik family (khandan) ki pehchan banata hai. Functional group organic compound ka woh hissa hai jahan zyada tar reactions hote hain. Organic synthesis mein hum saada aur aasani se milne wale ajza (components) se target molecule (jo molecule banana hai) banane ke mukhtalif mumkin raaste sochte hain. Synthesis ka mansooba banane mein functional groups markazi kirdar ada karte hain. In ki madad se chemists un reactions ka pehle se andaza lagate aur un ko control karte hain jo aakhir kaar matloob (desired) product tak le jate hain. Compound mein maujood functional group pehchan lene se us ki khasiyat (properties) ka andaza lagaya ja sakta hai. Yeh maloomat naye organic products banane ke liye, aur dawaiyon aur khurak mein dale jane wale maaddon (food additives) jaise products ki purity (khalis-pan) aur composition (banawat) yaqeeni banane ke liye bohat zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Organic synthesis ka mansooba banane mein functional groups markazi kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Compound ke zyada tar reactions functional group par hote hain. Is liye functional groups jaan kar chemist andaza laga sakta hai aur control kar sakta hai ke kaun se reactions target molecule tak le jayenge.

items: Functional group: compound ka woh hissa jahan zyada tar reactions hote hain.
Organic synthesis: saada, aasani se milne wale ajza se target molecule banana.
Functional group pehchan kar compound ki properties ka andaza lagta hai.
